experiment: C6 exploratory two-level hierarchical Canaria recompilation
interpretation: Level-2 joint adaptation using only lower-level Canaria IR targets improved the final depth-two recursive single relative to no Level-2 adaptation in all three exploratory seeds.
The incremental depth-two cost relative to a flat single compiled directly from the same lower-level Canaria IR was small: 1.007x to 1.027x NMSE ratio.
Direct original-teacher compilation remained materially better, with depth-two/direct ratios around 1.65x to 1.72x.
The dominant error therefore appears to be inherited from the lower-level Canaria IR rather than created by the extra hierarchy level itself.
No held-out test data was evaluated; this result only motivates a fresh confirmatory depth-two cohort.
